description: FLASH Content OS - Mandatory Regression Rules and Defect Safeguards. Every rule has an automated regression test proven to FAIL on past bad samples and PASS on valid samples.

rules.description: Commands must be verifiable verbatim from repo README/docs. Forbids fake packages (e.g. 'npx @damir/unslop'), mismatched model commands (e.g. qwen2.5 under Qwen 3.6), unsafe flags ('--dangerously-skip-permissions'), and broken mid-token words.

No invented headings ('Hierarchical Task Decomposer', 'Neural Activation Vectors'), no unsourced claims ('4x higher throughput', 'viral', 'breakthrough'), no self-praise or internal labels ('Source Truth Gates: 100% Tested', 'Zero Hallucinations', 'VERIFIED', 'GROUNDED', 'TECHNICAL ESSAY TAKEAWAY', '[03/08]', 'WOW BEAT'), no chapter labels ('CHAPTER 01 - ...') or slide numbering, and NO DATES anywhere inside the video.

No Telugu unicode script on screen (romanized Tenglish Latin characters only). No relative time words in English or romanized Telugu ('yesterday', 'ninna', 'today', 'last week', 'repu', 'tomorrow'). Spelled-out numbers forbidden on screen (must use digits: '5' not 'five', '100' not 'hundred').

Numbers must agree identically between video on-screen text, Pages essays, and Instagram captions. Counters cannot show 0 as a shot. Screenshot URL bars must match the exact repo URL (not org page or missing path). Cookie banners strictly forbidden in captures.

Forbids frozen captions (> 1.5s while speech continues) and captions mismatched to voice. CTA must start strictly AFTER the last content word. Audio sample rate 48 kHz (not 96 kHz), true peak <= -1.5 dBTP, and integrated loudness strictly -14.0 +/- 0.5 LUFS for both master and 720p web copy.

Perceptual-hash uniqueness check prevents repeated images/crops. Text contrast >= 4.5:1 with no ghosted text. Hero visual >= 45% height with no empty dark voids. Motion MAD median >= 1.0, burst second > 20, <= 3 consecutive seconds below 0.5. Phase correlation jitter variance <= 0.05 px^2. No top-right link chip; lower-third source domain only while capture is on screen.

Review action buttons must generate well-formed URLs without syntax errors (e.g. no 'author:new:'). All query parameters must be safely encoded with encodeURIComponent and parseable via standard URL parser.
